title: Casper and the Tryouts
author: Paloma Underhill
blurb: Astrid Reyes, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
